verdicts.evidence: The logbook states the five datasets (ADFTD, APAVA, PTB, PTB-XL, TDBRAIN) with seeds 41-45 were never run; only an APAVA shell script was found in the released repository, with no checkpoints or cached metrics.
No dataset experiments were executed, so the 20 top-1 and 3 top-2 results out of 30 entries cannot be verified or refuted.

The temporal-difference operator's first step equals the input (max abs 72.0) instead of zero as declared, and the frequency filter has shape [12] (feature-wise only) broadcast across all 9 FFT bins with no frequency axis, meaning it cannot selectively amplify or suppress physiological bands.

Two strongly different inputs produce identical adjacency (max |delta|=0.0), mutating graph parameters changes adjacency by 0.502 but changes the output by exactly 0.0, and all classification-proxy gradients to graph parameters (nodevec1, nodevec2, dynamic_gate) are null, showing the graph is static and disconnected from the classifier.
The logbook does not address computational complexity scaling; no FLOPs, timing, or asymptotic scaling experiments were performed.

overall: The logbook provides concrete structural, mutation, and gradient tests showing that the released MedMamba implementation does not match the paper's described TDSSE or SGM modules: the difference operator and frequency filter are mis-implemented, and the learned graph is static and disconnected from the output. The five-dataset accuracy claims and the complexity claim are not addressed by any executed experiments.
